message: Running command: for pid in $(ls /proc | grep -E '^[0-9]+$'); do if [ -f /proc/$pid/cmdline ]; then cmd=$(cat /proc/$pid/cmdline 2>/dev/null | tr '\0' ' '); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q "node server.js"; then echo "Killing PID $pid"; kill $pid 2>/dev/null; fi; fi; done && sleep 2 && curl -s http://localhost:4173/api/health || echo "Server stopped"
